description: This file contains SCSS mixins for constructing a responsive grid system with various column sizes and offsets, for different screen sizes.

methods.name: container-fixed
methods.description: Creates a centered container with specified gutter width.

methods.name: make-row
methods.description: Creates a wrapper for a series of columns with spacing.

methods.name: make-xs-column
methods.description: Defines styles for extra small columns.

methods.name: make-sm-column
methods.description: Defines styles for small columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-sm-column-offset
methods.description: Offsets small columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-sm-column-push
methods.description: Pushes small columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-sm-column-pull
methods.description: Pulls small columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-md-column
methods.description: Defines styles for medium columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-md-column-offset
methods.description: Offsets medium columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-md-column-push
methods.description: Pushes medium columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-md-column-pull
methods.description: Pulls medium columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-lg-column
methods.description: Defines styles for large columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-lg-column-offset
methods.description: Offsets large columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-lg-column-push
methods.description: Pushes large columns with media queries.

methods.name: make-lg-column-pull
methods.description: Pulls large columns with media queries.
